{{TooltipSprite||Pink Wool}} {{Map color|Pink}} }} }} '''Wool''' is a [[block]] obtained from [[sheep]] that can be [[dye]]d in any of the sixteen different [[Dyeing|colors]]. It can be used as a crafting material and to block [[vibration]]s. == Obtaining == === Breaking === Wool can be broken using any [[tool]], but [[shears]] are the fastest tool to use. {{breaking row|horizontal=1|Wool|shears=1}} === Natural generation === ; Woodland mansion All wool colors (except magenta, pink, and purple) generate naturally as part of structures within [[woodland mansion]]s. ; Village White and yellow wool generate in shepherd houses, fletcher houses, and meeting points in [[plains]] [[village]]s. 10 light gray wool generate under the [[door]] and on the floor of {{code|Snowy_small_house_8}} in [[snowy tundra]] villages. ; Pillager outpost White wool generates as tents outside [[pillager outpost]]s. ; Ancient city Gray wool appears on some walls and on the floors of long corridors at the corners of an [[ancient city]]. The wool damps vibrations, preventing activation of nearby sculk blocks. Ancient cities can also generate blue, cyan, and light blue wool. === Mob loot === {{control|use|text=Using}} [[shears]] on an adult [[sheep]] yields 1–3 wool. Sheep also drop 1 wool upon death, if they are not sheared. The wool dropped is the same color as the sheep, unless the sheep is named '''jeb_''', in which case the sheep drops whatever color the sheep truly is instead of rainbow wool. The drop rates are not affected by the [[Fortune]] or [[Looting]] [[enchantment]]s. Baby sheep cannot be sheared. Sheep can spawn with different colors. The most common color is determined by the type of [[biome]] the sheep spawns in. In temperate biomes the most common color is white, in cold biomes it is black and in warm biomes it is brown. However sheep can spawn in all three of these colors, and light and dark grey, in all biomes. Sheep can also naturally spawn with pink wool but this has a rare chance.https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-1-21-70-bedrock-changelog {{Drop sources|Wool}} === Generated loot === {{LootChestItem|black-wool,white-wool,gray-wool,light-gray-wool,brown-wool}} === Crafting === {{Crafting |head=1 |A2=String |B2=String |A3=String |B3=String |Output=White Wool |type=Building block |showdescription=1 }} {{Crafting |Any Wool |Matching Dye |Output=Matching Wool |showdescription=1 |description= |type=Building block }} {{Crafting |Any Dyed Wool |Bleach |Output=White Wool |showdescription=1 |description={{only|bedrock|education}} |type=Building block |foot=1 }}

=== Trading === {{Trade sources|Any color Wool}} === Villager gifts === {{IN|Java}}, a shepherd [[villager]] may throw a block of wool of random color at a player under the [[Hero of the Village]] effect. == Usage == Wool comes in sixteen colors, which are white, light gray, gray, black, brown, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, and pink. Unlike [[stained glass]] and [[terracotta]], the white variant serves as the undyed block. Wool of any color can be re-dyed into any other color. Wool is easily mined, highly flammable, and offers little resistance against [[explosion]]s. === Trading === {{Trade uses|White Wool|Brown Wool|Black Wool|Gray Wool}} === Vibration occlusion === Wool can be used to block [[vibration]]s from reaching nearby [[sculk sensor]]s. If a wool block is placed between a sensor and a vibration source, the sensor is not able to detect vibrations behind it. Similarly, if a wool block is placed between a sensor and a [[sculk shrieker]], the sensor is unable to alert the shrieker. Sculk sensors are not able to detect the placing and breaking of wool, as well as entities [[walking]], [[sprinting]], or [[jumping]] on top of it. They are also unable to detect [[Item (entity)|items]] dropped on wool, or wool itself dropped in item form. Similar to sculk sensors, [[warden]]s are also unable to detect everything wool-related as listed above. Wool can also be used to block [[Note Block|note block]] sounds from reaching [[Allay|allays]]. === Crafting ingredient === Any color of wool can be used for paintings, but it has no effect on the product's final appearance. {{crafting usage|Any Wool}} === Fuel === {{IN|Java}}, wool can be used as fuel in [[furnace]]s and [[Furnace (disambiguation)|their variants]], smelting 0.5 items per wool It can only be obtained by killing a zombie using a [[charged creeper]]'s [[explosion]]. == Obtaining == === Breaking === No tool can accelerate the breaking process of zombie head.{{bug|MC-192905||Heads & Skulls have no assigned tool}} {{breaking row|horizontal=1|Zombie Head}} Zombie head drops itself when it's destroyed. When destroyed by an [[explosion]], the zombie head always drops as an item. === Mob loot === Zombie heads are always dropped by a [[zombie]] if it dies due to a [[charged creeper]]'s explosion. {{IN|bedrock}}, if multiple mobs are killed by the same charged creeper, all of them drop their heads, however {{in|java}} only one mob selected at random drops its head.{{bug|MC-63534|||WAI}} {{Drop sources|Zombie Head}} == Usage == === Decoration === Zombie heads can be oriented in 16 different directions on top of a block, and 4 directions on the sides of blocks, similar to [[sign]]s. They can be placed on top of, or beside each other by shift clicking. === Wearing === {{See also|#Renders}} The [[player]] can wear zombie heads, similarly to [[carved pumpkin]]s or helmets. This overlays the second layer of the player's [[skin]]. ==== Disguise ==== Wearing a zombie head reduces the detection range for [[zombie]]s to 50% of the normal range. This is similar to (and stacks with) the reductions in detection range from [[sneaking]] and from the [[Invisibility]] status effect. {{IN|bedrock}}, wearing a zombie head makes the player invisible to other players on a locator [[map]]. ==== Locator bar ==== Like all other mob heads, a zombie head can be worn by a player to hide their location, as it will prevent other players from finding them using the [[locator bar]]. === Dispensers === A [[dispenser]] can equip a zombie head on a player, mob, or armor stand with an empty helmet slot, within the block the dispenser is facing. === Crafting ingredient=== {{Crafting |ignoreusage=1 |ingredients=Zombie head +

They can be [[dye]]d in all 16 colors. == Obtaining == === Breaking === Wool stairs can be broken using any [[tool]], but [[shears]] are the fastest. {{breaking row|horizontal=1|Wool Stairs|shears=1}} === Natural generation === White wool stairs generate naturally as part of structures within [[abandoned camp]]s. === Crafting === {{Crafting |head=1 |A1= Matching Wool |A2= Matching Wool |B2= Matching Wool |A3= Matching Wool |B3= Matching Wool |C3= Matching Wool |Output= Matching Wool Stairs,4 |type= Building block }} {{Crafting |Any Wool Stairs |Matching Dye |Output=Matching Wool Stairs |type=Building block |foot=1 }} == Usage == {{for|information about the placement mechanics of all stairs|Stairs#Usage}} Wool stairs come in sixteen colors, which are white, light gray, gray, black, brown, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, and pink. Just like the wool block, the white variant serves as the undyed block. Wool stairs of any color can be re-dyed into any other color. Wool stairs are easily mined, highly flammable, and offer little resistance against [[explosion]]s. === Vibration occlusion === Contrary to popular belief, wool stairs cannot be used to block [[vibration]]s from reaching nearby [[sculk sensor]]s. If wool stairs are placed between a sensor and a vibration source, the sensor is somehow still able to detect vibrations behind it. If wool stairs are placed between a sensor and a [[sculk shrieker]], the sensor is able to alert the shrieker. This also applies to [[Allay|allays]] hearing note blocks and [[Warden|wardens]] hearing sounds. Although they don't work for occluding, sculk sensors are not able to detect the placing and breaking of wool stairs, as well as entities [[walking]], [[sprinting]], or [[jumping]] on top of it. They are also unable to detect [[Item (entity)|items]] dropped on wool stairs, or wool stairs itself dropped in item form. === Fuel === {{IN|Java}}, wool stairs can be used as fuel in [[furnace]]s and [[Furnace (disambiguation)|their variants]], smelting 0.5 items per block of wool stairs. == Sounds == {{Sound table/Block/Wool}} == Data values == === ID === {{JE}}: {{ID table |edition=java '''{{BE|short=1}}''': Guitar {{upcoming|26.60}} }} A '''wool slab''' is a craftable [[slab]] variant of [[wool]]. It can be [[dye]]d in all 16 colors. == Obtaining == === Breaking === Wool slabs can be broken using any [[tool]], but [[shears]] are the fastest. {{breaking row|horizontal=1|Wool Slab|shears=1}} === Crafting === {{Crafting |head=1 |A3= Matching Wool |B3= Matching Wool |C3= Matching Wool |Output= Matching Wool Slab,6 |type= Building block }} {{Crafting |Any Wool Slab |Matching Dye |Output=Matching Wool Slab |type=Building block |foot=1 }} == Usage == {{for|information about the placement mechanics of all slabs|Slab#Usage}}Wool slabs come in sixteen colors, which are white, light gray, gray, black, brown, red, orange, yellow, lime, green, cyan, light blue, blue, purple, magenta, and pink. Just like the wool block, the white variant serves as the undyed block. Wool slabs of any color can be re-dyed into any other color, just like [[wool]] can be re-dyed. Wool slabs are easily mined, highly flammable, and offer little resistance against [[explosion]]s. === Crafting ingredient === {{crafting usage|Matching Wool Slab,Any Wool Slab}} === Vibration occlusion === Contrary to popular belief, wool slabs cannot be used to block [[Vibration|vibrations]] from reaching nearby [[Sculk sensor|sculk sensors]]. If wool slabs are placed between a sensor and a vibration source, the sensor is somehow still able to detect vibrations behind it. If wool slabs are placed between a sensor and a [[sculk shrieker]], the sensor is able to alert the shrieker. This also applies to [[Allay|allays]] hearing note blocks and [[Warden|wardens]] hearing sounds. If two wool slabs are stacked to make a [[Slab#Placement|block]], the vibrations can still pass through to the [[Sculk Sensor|sculk sensor]]. Although they don't work for occluding, sculk sensors are not able to detect the placing and breaking of wool slabs, as well as entities [[walking]], [[sprinting]], or [[jumping]] on top of it. They are also unable to detect [[Item (entity)|items]] dropped on wool slabs, or wool slabs itself dropped in item form. === Fuel === {{IN|Java}}, wool slabs can be used as fuel in furnaces and their
